It is the case of the petitioner that on 
the last transfer session, her transfer was 
stayed by this Court on 23.06.2023 in WPSS 
No.919 of 2023. In this year’s transfer list, 
the name of the petitioner was not reflected, 
but suddenly, she has been transferred. 
Learned State Counsel seeks time to get 
instructions in the matter. 
List this matter on 20.06.2025, just 
after fresh cases. 
 (Ravindra Maithani J.)

Vijay Laxmi
--Petitioner
 Versus
State Of Uttarakhand And Others
--Respondents
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. C.S. Rawat, learned counsel for the 
petitioner.
2. Mr. S.S. Chaudhary, learned Standing 
Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand.
3. The petitioner has impugned the
transfer order dated 10.06.2025 (Annexure 5 
to the writ petition), whereby the petitioner 
has been transferred from Government 
Ayurvedic Hospital, Dharampur, Dehradun 
to Government Ayurvedic Hospital, 
Simalkhet Champawat.
4. It is an admitted position that there is 
no order staying the transfer order of 
petitioner yet the petitioner has chosen not
to join at the transferred place; further it is 
informed that petitioner has proceeded on 
long medical leave for the last one year. This 
is something highly objectionable.
5. The respondent-State is directed to 
relieve the petitioner forthwith for the 
transferred place.
6. List this matter on 04.11.2026.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 29.09.2026
R.Bisht
